title: Formal smoothness of the closed fibre passes to completions
statement: Let $f:A\to B$ be a local map of Noetherian local rings [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]. Write $A^\wedge$ and $B^\wedge$ for their maximal-ideal completions [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion]. Let $\psi:A^\wedge\to B^\wedge$ be a local map commuting with the canonical maps: $\psi c_A=c_B f$. Put $I=f(\mathfrak m_A)B$ and $\widehat I=\psi(\mathfrak m_{A^\wedge})B^\wedge$. Give both closed fibres their canonical residue-field algebra structures [def-weil-pbc-algebra-hom-quotient]. If $B/I$ is formally smooth over $A/\mathfrak m_A$ for the image of $\mathfrak m_B$ [def-weil-pbc-formally-smooth-adic], then $B^\wedge/\widehat I$ is formally smooth over $A^\wedge/\mathfrak m_{A^\wedge}$ for the image of $\mathfrak m_{B^\wedge}$.

source.place: Tag 07NQ, opening completion reduction; Tag 07ED (1) implies (2), and quotient completion Tag 0325; accessed at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/07NQ and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/07ED

proof.text: Put I=m_A B, C=B/I, n=m_B C. For the commuting map ψ:Ahat→Bhat, m_Ahat=m_A Ahat, so Ihat=m_Ahat Bhat=I Bhat. This is Ideal.map_map applied to the commutation identity. No flatness is used.

Apply completion of the surjection B→C. Its kernel is I. The resulting ring isomorphism e:Bhat/Ihat→Chat sends the class of cB(b) to cC([b]); keep this formula from exists_local_completion_quotient. The residue-field map cA induces a bijective map eA:k→khat.

Complete the formally smooth k-algebra C at n, using finite generation of n in the Noetherian quotient C. This gives formal smoothness of Chat at n Chat. Change the base from k to khat using eA inverse and formallySmoothAdic.of_ringEquiv.

Upgrade e to a khat-algebra equivalence: by surjectivity of eA and of A→k it suffices to check scalars represented by cA(a); the formula for e and ψcA=cBf give the equality. Its image of m_Bhat(Bhat/Ihat) is n Chat, by m_Bhat=m_B Bhat and the same formula for e. Precompose a test map with the inverse algebra equivalence, solve the lifting problem on Chat, and compose the lift back. Ideal.map_pow transports the continuity witness, and the inverse identities prove the quotient equality. This is the private, fully proved formallySmoothAdic_of_algEquiv helper.
